purpose: Broaden the FSFFL Projection Championship beyond the initial Razzball/FFToday/Native comparison while keeping predictive accuracy, historical freeze quality, source independence, access cost, and intended-use rights as separate gates.

tiers.TIER_1_DIRECT_CHAMPIONSHIP: Current raw-stat projections available and/or leakage-safe historical raw-stat evidence exists. Highest priority for normalization and common-cohort testing.
tiers.TIER_2_EXPANSION_CANDIDATE: Credible raw-stat projection system exists, but historical freeze/access/rights evidence needs additional work.
tiers.TIER_3_META_BENCHMARK: Useful consensus or aggregate benchmark, but source overlap prevents treating it as an independent ensemble vote.
tiers.TIER_4_RESEARCH_ONLY: Potentially informative but access, schema, historical provenance, or rights make near-term raw-stat championship use uncertain.

sources.why_interesting: FFA 2014-2025 positional study reports CBS strongest historically at RB; current CBS pages expose detailed passing/rushing/receiving projection columns.

sources.independence_note: FantasyPros consensus may aggregate multiple analysts; do not simultaneously count a constituent and the consensus as fully independent without overlap controls.

sources.why_interesting: Current season projection interface exposes passing, rushing and receiving raw-stat columns and a projection download control.
4for4 publishes sortable projections with relevant positional statistics and reports a long record of forecast/ranking accuracy.
Current 2026 projections explicitly model raw passing, rushing, receiving, targets and injury/depth-chart context.
Current 2026 projection tool covers 500+ players, multiple scoring formats and CSV export, but subscription access limits near-term production use.
FFA reports a 12-season study where source aggregation was highly robust and simple average slightly outperformed historical weighting overall.
sources.overlap_warning: Do not count FFA Average as an independent vote alongside the same providers included inside its consensus.

implemented_in_this_workstream: Generic CSV/JSON current-source raw-stat normalizer with deterministic self-test.
Historical Projection Benchmark CI coverage for expanded source governance and normalization.
next_actions: Run the 2014 four-source raw-stat scorecard and retain it as single-season category-prior evidence only.
Acquire and normalize current 2026 CBS and FFToday snapshots with immutable freeze metadata.
Acquire FantasyPros current projections through an allowed personal/noncommercial path and document overlap controls.
Evaluate Footballguys current raw-stat download and historical snapshot provenance.
Verify 4for4 and RotoWire historical raw-stat availability and terms.
Run temporal category championships whenever at least two admissible sources overlap across enough seasons.
Do not change live 2026 source authority until the expanded board produces category-level held-out evidence and rights-aware deployment decisions.
